title: Compass Point Condo #308 | KEY.co
description_expanded: Functionality meets sophistication in the kitchen, where stainless appliances and granite countertops are highlighted by a vibrant aqua subway tile backsplash. An expansive island with barstools, along with a large dining table, offers ample dining space, while a balcony off the kitchen provides an alternative spot for al fresco meals or sunset viewing. The condo boasts three bedrooms, each with unobstructed gulf views, ensuring that waking up to the serene waters is a daily luxury. The master suite, with its majestic vistas, features a king-sized bed and an en-suite that includes both a shower and a soaking tub. Additional amenities like dedicated office space, in-unit laundry facilities, private pool access, and a beach walkover ensure that every aspect of living here is as convenient as it is luxurious. This condo isn't just a dwelling—it's a lifestyle statement, offering both the tranquility of the seaside and the comforts of a thoughtfully designed home.
